closed_findings.evidence: Reviewed collector lines 177-248: positive st_size equals consumed count only after identical before/after/current device, inode, mode, link-count, size, mtime and ctime signatures. No extra read beyond granted bytes; nofollow, regular-file and single-link checks remain. Zero st_size cannot take completeness shortcut; header handling remains separate. Independently executed cap-1/cap/cap+1 probe accepts first two and rejects last. Scoped tests also pass exact remaining global budget, read-count assertions, zero-size virtual-record and unstable-file regressions.

Reviewed collector lines 567-576: metadata-only ordering ranks python.json first, dotted numeric version/build Python filenames next, unrelated python-prefixed packages last. Both repository priority regressions pass. Independent 80000-byte-budget probe retains Python 3.12.1 rather than python-dateutil.

Reviewed importer lines 62-71 and manager dispatch: original alphanumeric-leading grammar including + and : is retained, with narrow underscore-leading alternative for Conda only and never system packages. Executed legacy no-details report import/review regressions across Conda/venv/unknown, plus underscore scope and invalid punctuation tests.

Reviewed complete _finish normalization/truncation region: editable candidate requires removable records; every iteration strictly reduces serialized byte size or collapses issues/links and renormalizes; failure to progress raises fixed ValueError. Executed regression with 350 long limit issues for both empty editable mapping and retained empty-record environment, under independent two-second SIGALRM; both terminate, retain report-size-limit, remain bounded and validate.

Reviewed workspace/details mapping guards before optional-key membership and parent path validation before requested-name concatenation. Executed null/scalar/list/empty-mapping and invalid-parent regressions expecting fixed InventoryError, plus three malformed CLI report cases refusing without output. No raw TypeError remains in these reviewed cases.
